sentences.en: Store them in an airtight container, and when you share them, you can put them in Ziploc bags decorated for the occasion.

sentences.en: If you want to be certain what type of worm it is (and this can help you know how to treat the worms), wipe the worm off your cat's behind with a piece of tissue, and put it into a Ziploc bag with a small piece of damp paper towel.

sentences.en: You should also take a stool sample in a clean container such as a Ziploc bag.

sentences.en: While you can put your child's lunch items into Ziploc baggies, you can cut down on costs by purchasing some small Tupperware or Gladware containers.

sentences.en: Most dogs are ready to have a bowel movement first thin in the morning, so you'll want to have a clean Ziploc bag ready and label it with a marker.

sentences.en: In addition to these items, also plan to take guidebooks with you, pen and paper as well as Ziploc bags for keeping things dry.

sentences.en: Do this with several more rhyming pairs and store in a Ziploc baggie.

sentences.en: For example, Ziploc makes very low-cost containers that are designed to be thrown away after just a few uses.

sentences.en: Cubes or balls of the melon can be placed in Tupperware or a Ziploc bag for a quick hit of energy on the go.

sentences.en: On the night before the party, place each item into a Ziploc bag, fill half of the bag with water and then stack them in a freezer so that the lingerie is frozen inside a layer of water.
sentences.vi: Vào đêm trước bữa tiệc, hãy cho từng món đồ vào một túi Ziploc, đổ nước vào một nửa túi rồi xếp chúng vào tủ đá để nội y đông lại bên trong một lớp nước.
